name: Valkmir
description: The glassy black lake made from the blood of the first Valkyrie who died during the world's creation, from which all Valkyries were birthed.

pages_say.description: The black mirror lake of Starnheim, 'blood and bone' of the Valkyries.

citation.text: "Aim Through the Target" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2021.
